related.title: AutoStore 立體倉儲系統
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付路網占用表、容量計算與等待時間分解。；離線模擬需達 250 架次/h、無對向死鎖且每個任務可追溯起訖時間。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver route occupancy, capacity calculation and waiting-time breakdown.; Offline simulation must reach 250 trips/h without head-on deadlock and with traceable start/end times.
related.difference: 量化深層挖箱對延遲的影響，理解平均延遲不能代表尾端。
related.differenceEn: Quantify digging delay and distinguish average from tail latency.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 無互相干擾時 q=N×3600/T；交通等待必須加進 T。；教學車隊 10 台，單次循環 120 s，需求 250 架次/h。；q=10×3600/120=300 架次/h。
簡化檢索時間 T=(d−1)tr+tt+tp，其中 d 為目標深度。；教學 d=5、每上層挪箱 4 s、運送 12 s、呈現 8 s。；T=(5−1)×4+12+8=36 s。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Without interference, q=N×3600/T; traffic waiting adds to T.; Teaching fleet: ten robots, 120 s cycle and demand 250 shelf trips/h.; q=10×3600/120=300 shelf trips/h.
Simplified retrieval time T=(d−1)tr+tt+tp, where d is target depth.; Teaching d=5, relocation 4 s, transport 12 s and presentation 8 s.; T=(5−1)×4+12+8=36 s.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: TRUMPF TruLaser 雷射切割平台
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付路網占用表、容量計算與等待時間分解。；離線模擬需達 250 架次/h、無對向死鎖且每個任務可追溯起訖時間。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver route occupancy, capacity calculation and waiting-time breakdown.; Offline simulation must reach 250 trips/h without head-on deadlock and with traceable start/end times.
related.difference: 區分零件面積利用率與含切縫、夾持邊的可行排版。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish area utilization from feasible nesting with kerf and clamping margins.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 無互相干擾時 q=N×3600/T；交通等待必須加進 T。；教學車隊 10 台，單次循環 120 s，需求 250 架次/h。；q=10×3600/120=300 架次/h。
面積利用率 η=N Ap/As，只是必要篩選，不能證明幾何可排。；教學 N=40 件，每件 60×40 mm，板面 400×300 mm。；η=40×60×40/(400×300)=0.80=80%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Without interference, q=N×3600/T; traffic waiting adds to T.; Teaching fleet: ten robots, 120 s cycle and demand 250 shelf trips/h.; q=10×3600/120=300 shelf trips/h.
Area yield η=N Ap/As is a screening measure, not proof of geometric packability.; Teaching N=40 parts of 60×40 mm on a 400×300 mm sheet.; η=40×60×40/(400×300)=0.80=80%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
